summary_md:
# Nya toppduon vänder kriskedjan

**Feed**: kort-och-lang  
**Published**: 2026-08-17  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Season-premiere episode of Kort & Lång (Dagens Industri). The hosts note calm markets, with the VIX at its 2026 low and very easy financing conditions despite tariff threats, rising US long-term rates and geopolitical risk, and are uneasy about how much depends on AI capex. Robert Andersson warns that Swedish engineering stocks look expensive and suggests Volvo over the more AI-exposed Atlas Copco. Johan Wendel pitches Adidas as a long-term play on the running and health trend. Julia Forsberg Thulin says Kjell & Company's turnaround is gaining traction and calls the high-risk stock a buy.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 KJELL — Kjell & Company | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Q2 shows the first growth since Q4 2024, better product margins and availability, stock building ahead of peak season, and a strong CEO, chair and new purchasing head.

#### Reasoning

Host Julia Forsberg Thulin thinks the turnaround is gaining traction: growth is back, supplier deals and warehousing have been reworked, availability and product margins are better, and management has been strengthened (CEO Sandra Gadd, chair Göran Westerberg). High debt adds leverage if the turnaround continues, but the risk is high, so she advises a small position.

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth reverts to negative
- if costs stay too high to lift profitability
- if the high debt becomes a problem
- if the Q4 season disappoints

> *"Men jag tycker ändå att man kan köpa Kjell."*

---

### 🟢 ADS — Adidas | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Growth from market-share gains, better margins, valuation of about 12x EV/EBIT, strong brand, and a structural health and running trend. Pitched for a long-term buy-and-hold portfolio.

#### Reasoning

Host Johan Wendel, backed by Robert Andersson, calls Adidas their favourite way to play the global health and running trend. It is gaining share with high single-digit growth, margins are recovering after the pandemic and Russia hits, the valuation has fallen to about 12x EV/EBIT, and iconic retro products are selling well again. After nearly a lost decade on the stock market, they see a possible comeback.

#### Sell Triggers

- if market-share gains reverse
- if margins weaken again
- if consumer purchasing power weakens

> *"Adidas, denna tyska... globala jätte som jag tycker är väldigt lämplig om man vill ta rygg på den här trenden."*

---

### 🟢 VOLV-B — AB Volvo | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Less AI exposure than other engineering stocks. Suggested as the engineering choice for investors who worry that AI-driven earnings are near their peak.

#### Reasoning

Host Robert Andersson thinks Swedish engineering stocks look expensive after gaining from data-centre capex that may peak. Johan suggests picking the less AI-exposed Volvo, and Robert agrees it is worth paying more for companies whose earnings are not boosted by AI in the short term.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the truck and construction cycle weakens
- if engineering sector multiples compress across the board

> *"Då kanske man ska välja Volvo till portföljen om man är lite orolig för den AI."*

---

### 🔴 ATCO-A — Atlas Copco | **SELL** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Heavily exposed to AI and data-centre expansion at a time when engineering valuations look stretched. Summed up half-jokingly as 'sell Atlas, buy Volvo'.

#### Reasoning

Robert worries that engineering stocks have been boosted by data-centre capex that could fade in a few years, so current earnings may be peak earnings that deserve lower multiples. Atlas Copco is the example of high AI exposure. The call is lightly held and half-joking.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI capex accelerates beyond expectations and analysts raise estimates

> *"Robbans tillbaka från semestertrade. Sälj Atlas, köp Volvo. Ja, så blir det."*

---

### 🟠 NEWA-B — New Wave | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Reports Thursday, after weak reports from peers Björn Borg and Revolution Race.

#### Reasoning

Julia says it will be interesting to see New Wave's report after weak results from Björn Borg and Revolution Race in the same sector. Robert mentions that Craft shoes were common at an alpine race, possibly a sign of a turn, but no directional call is made.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Thursday report is weak like its peers'

> *"Så det ska bli intressant att se hur det går för New Wave nu."*

---
